preconditions: Physical on-hand is 10.000000: lot L1 has 4.000000 and lot L2 has 6.000000.
Quality hold Q and recall hold R independently cover all four L1 units; an active reservation covers 2.000000 eligible L2 units.
cases.action: Read availability, release Q with its authorized command, attempt issue from L1, then independently release R and read availability again.
expected_persistent_result: Initial physical on-hand is 10.000000, union of held quantity is 4.000000, active reserved eligible quantity is 2.000000 and available quantity is 4.000000.
Releasing Q leaves R active: held quantity stays 4.000000, available stays 4.000000 and an ordinary L1 issue remains denied.
Only after authorized release of R does held quantity become zero and available become 8.000000; on-hand remains 10.000000 throughout.
Each hold retains its own reason, owner, source, scope and release audit; releasing one never rewrites another hold or creates a stock movement.
failure_result: Subtracting eight held units for two overlapping holds, clearing all holds through one quality action, or trusting a single summary status fails the gate.

cases.title: Enforce independent output-specific animal restrictions
preconditions: Animal A has treatment T1 meat restriction ending 2027-01-17T08:00:00Z and milk restriction ending 2027-01-12T08:00:00Z.
Treatment T2 independently restricts meat until 2027-01-20T08:00:00Z and milk until 2027-01-14T08:00:00Z; dates/rules are synthetic approved fixtures.
All unrelated eligibility is satisfied.
cases.action: At 2027-01-15T08:00:00Z test milk and meat eligibility; authorize a correction releasing only T1, attempt to override the animal summary date directly, then test meat at the T2 boundary.
expected_persistent_result: At the first instant milk is eligible under these restrictions, while meat is blocked by active T1 and T2 restrictions.
Releasing/correcting T1 leaves T2 meat restriction active until its exact end; a summary-date edit grants no authority and cannot permit the blocked dispatch.
At 2027-01-20T08:00:00Z meat becomes eligible only because every applicable independent meat restriction has ended; milk history remains separately inspectable.
Restriction rows preserve output/purpose, source treatment, rule revision, interval and authorized correction; the displayed withdrawal summary is a projection.
failure_result: Using a single withdrawal_end field as authority, clearing unrelated treatment restrictions or applying meat duration indiscriminately to milk fails the gate.

cases.title: Recognize a customer deposit and apply it without duplicate revenue
preconditions: Native accounting is active; approved synthetic recognition policy treats the advance as a liability.
Customer pays NAD 2,000.00 against an agreed service that will later be invoiced at NAD 4,000.00; taxes disabled.
cases.action: Receive the deposit, issue the earned-service invoice at the approved recognition point, allocate the deposit and retry the allocation.
expected_persistent_result: Deposit receipt debits bank NAD 2,000.00 and credits customer deposits NAD 2,000.00 with no earned revenue.
Invoice debits receivables NAD 4,000.00 and credits service revenue NAD 4,000.00.
Application debits customer deposits NAD 2,000.00 and credits receivables NAD 2,000.00; deposit remainder is zero and invoice remainder NAD 2,000.00.
Retry creates zero additional allocation or revenue; total recognized service revenue stays NAD 4,000.00.
failure_result: Recognizing revenue both on advance and again on invoicing, or applying the deposit twice, fails native accounting.

cases.title: Preserve restricted flock ancestry through split and individualisation
preconditions: Unindividualised group G contains 100 sheep covered by active synthetic meat restriction R until 2027-01-20T08:00:00Z.
No evidence identifies an unaffected subset; all input counts and source versions are valid.
cases.action: Split 30 sheep into G2, then individually identify 5 from G2; attempt a meat disposition of those 5 before R ends and repeat the split request key.
expected_persistent_result: Counts reconcile as G 70, G2 unindividualised 25 and 5 identified animals, total 100.
G2 and the 5 identities retain independently enforceable restrictions linked to original R; the meat disposition remains blocked.
Replaying the split creates no duplicate groups, animals, count changes or restriction ancestry.
If affected identities cannot be distinguished, all potentially affected descendants remain conservatively restricted until authorised evidence resolves them.
failure_result: A new group/tag/GUID clearing R, duplicated count or an atomic split without propagated restriction evidence fails the gate.

cases.title: Reject direct Ledger bypass of animal eligibility
preconditions: An individually tracked animal has one dedicated Ledger lot, stock quantity 1 and an active synthetic restriction on the requested disposition.
The actor may perform ordinary Ledger stock actions but may not release the applicable restriction.
cases.action: Try the blocked disposition through Ledger issue, sales delivery, adjustment and production use; attempt an arbitrary disposition override and repeat with the required Livestock provider unavailable.
expected_persistent_result: Every relevant path derives the actual disposition from its validated source and calls required owner eligibility before stock/valuation effects.
All blocked attempts leave quantity 1 and original value, restriction and source statuses unchanged, with no posted effects.
A missing required owner policy fails closed for the affected action; harmless authorised historical reads remain available.
A permitted relocation unrelated to the restricted purpose is evaluated under its own approved rule, not automatically treated as an illegal sale.
failure_result: Generic stock routes, arbitrary purpose text, missing provider or disabling a module bypassing an applicable restriction fails the gate.
